old_caption: The video captures a vibrant fireworks display against a dark night sky. Initially, the scene is dominated by a burst of golden sparks radiating outward from the center, creating a radiant starburst effect. As the sequence progresses, the fireworks transition into a series of intricate patterns, with bursts of white and gold lights spreading outwards, resembling delicate snowflakes or intricate floral designs. The camera pans slightly downward and to the right during the sequence, focusing on the spectacle above. The background is intermittently illuminated by the bright fireworks, and the lower portion of the frame shows smoke and faint ground-level structures, which are not consistently dark. The overall atmosphere is festive and celebratory, with each burst adding to the dynamic and mesmerizing visual experience.

Initially, the scene is dominated by a burst of golden sparks radiating outward from the center, creating a radiant starburst effect. As the sequence progresses, the fireworks transition into a series of intricate patterns, with bursts of white and gold lights spreading outwards, resembling delicate snowflakes or intricate floral designs. The camera remains stationary throughout, focusing on the spectacle above. The background is consistently dark, emphasizing the brightness and color of the fireworks. The overall atmosphere is festive and celebratory, with each burst adding to the dynamic and mesmerizing visual experience.
caption: The video captures a night-sky fireworks display against black, with a fan-shaped golden fountain at the bottom center and a thin power line crossing the frame. Two white starbursts already open at the top expand into larger golden radial bursts, then a bright flash erupts at the right. Multiple golden starbursts spread across the upper half while the central band of blue-white dots fades. The golden streaks develop dense clusters of twinkling white dots that slowly dim, and the fountain dissolves into smoke. The aerial points decay into sparse faint twinkles against the dark sky. A new bright white fountain then flares at the bottom center, growing and producing smoke.

endpoints are normal, not physical errors. Do not add unseen causes, onset, stopping or outcomes.
An internal editing cut is not evidence of physical motion connecting the views.

Check identification before physical interpretation: a reflection is not a separate actor;
a powder/smoke/liquid outline or shadow is not automatically the boundary of a solid object;
an apparent change caused by occlusion/viewpoint is not automatically material deformation.

camera tracking. A single visible texture/seam does not prove spin. Avoid unnecessary absolute
claims of stillness, no motion, no camera motion or 'exactly' synchronized changes.
Remove invented scene details and explanations, but keep clearly visible ongoing motion and
processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.

Complete every sentence. If accuracy requires a substantial length difference, explain it outside
the caption; do not fill missing context by imagination. Optional synonym edits are not needed.
